data.long_meaning: The name Goulden is derived from the Old English word 'golde' which means 'gold'. The name signifies one who is golden in nature and embodies the qualities of valor, wisdom and wealth. The name Goulden carries the meaning “Golden One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Goulden usually hope their child will grow to embody golden one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
